warnings.message: QT2 modifier is 0.85x (research RF-001) vs global standard 0.80x. Research justification is that closets still require basic adhesion prep even at economy tier. Acceptable variance from global standard.
TSK_CSRP_PRIME_BRUSH (general fallback primer) has empty applies_when {} but state_condition_note indicates it's conditional. This is technically 'always applies' per the applies_when pattern.
warnings.recommendation: Acceptable — the task exists as a fallback. Estimator selects the appropriate primer based on substrate state. In practice, if adhesion or stain-block primer is used, this task is not activated.

summary: SF_CLOSET_INT_RP_v1 passes all validation gates with zero issues. Simplest interior RP spec: 15 tasks across 6 modules (+ shared RRP containment), 4 material systems (3 RP primers + 1 finish), 15 consumables, 4 round configurations. QT2-QT3 only, brush_roll only. All cross-file threading verified. 2 minor warnings documented (QT2 modifier deviation, fallback primer applies_when). Ready for spec.json assembly.
